dedupe_keys.name: bangladesh spatial crop livestock emissions and mitigation scenarios

description: This Mendeley Data collection assembles crop and livestock management, soil and climate variables, estimated greenhouse-gas emissions and mitigation options across Bangladesh. The research team combined primary and secondary inputs and supplies eleven CSV files. Named files separate a 2014–2015 crop baseline from business-as-usual and mitigation cases for 2030 and 2050, with livestock, metadata and option-potential tables. The current public version 2 is free under CC BY 4.0. Spatial units are administrative and crop or livestock categories; these are not farm-by-farm observations or measured future emissions. Scenario values depend on the management and mitigation assumptions in the underlying study. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing agricultural emission pathways or providing spatial assumptions to food-system simulations. platform-global-food-twin is related by sector, but no file compatibility or validated integration is claimed. The article cites version 1 and contains supplementary ZIPs, while this record points to the current named CSV repository release. No source CSV or model output was downloaded.
